class Tagged {}
Object.defineProperty(Tagged, 'name', { value: Symbol('label'), configurable: true });
const value = new Tagged();
console.log(value);
console.dir(value, { showHidden: true });
let reads = 0;
Object.defineProperty(Tagged, 'name', {
  get() { reads++; return Symbol('label' + reads); },
});
console.log(value, reads);
console.dir(value, { showHidden: true });
console.log(reads);
Object.defineProperty(Tagged, 'name', { value: 17 });
console.log(value);
